q: Can a biogas plant at our factory or farm be funded with a green loan?
title: Green loan for a biogas plant
short: It can fit. The Green Loan Principles list renewable energy and waste-to-energy among eligible project types. The bank will want the feed and gas estimate, what fuel the gas replaces, and a way to report the result after commissioning, such as LPG or diesel no longer bought.
audience: Dairies, food processors and farms planning biogas

ul: Feed quantity per day and expected gas output, from the supplier or a DPR.
Current fuel bills for what the gas will replace.

p: Fuel bills before and after, with gas meter readings, show the saving. Keep methane leaks in mind: an unmanaged leak can cancel part of the benefit.

senseible: Senseible turns invoices and bills into a dated, fingerprinted emissions record a lender can trace line by line. The lender makes its own credit decision.

sources.label: IPCC AR6 Working Group I (global warming potentials)
